svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print 96 x 66 x 22 mm, walls and top plate 2 mm, open at the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print it top plate down on the bed; no supports needed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top plate: two 22 mm openings 22 mm each side of centre, to line up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the ports; four 3.4 mm holes at 80 x 50 mm for the screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right side: a 10 mm boss standing 8 mm proud, its centre 10 mm below

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top plate; a 2.5 mm gas way through it into the cup.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tap the boss M5 6 mm deep (drill 4.2) for the push-in fitting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside volume about 114 mL; it is the bump test cup.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the four M3 screws that hold the standoffs pass up through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top plate, so the cup is held flat under the head floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the openings sit over the ports; the fitting does not leak.
